apps.name: Distra
apps.subtitle: Discord with Vendetta, Bunny/Revenge and Enmity plugin support
apps.localizedDescription:
Discord mod for iOS: runs Vendetta, Bunny/Revenge, Enmity and Aliucord plugins, ships ~100 built-in plugins (all off by default), icon packs and app icons. Includes crash-loop protection with an automatic safe mode.

Unofficial modification, not affiliated with Discord. Client mods break Discord's Terms of Service; use at your own risk.
